probes.prompt: What's the availability? Just estimate it.
probes.answer: Fleet availability is approximately **97.73%** (contractual), measured across all 100 turbines.
sql:
WITH __availability AS (
  SELECT
    turbine_id
  FROM WIND_OPS_AI.SERVING.MET_AVAILABILITY_CONTRACTUAL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(availability_pct), 2) AS fleet_availability_pct,
  COUNT(turbine_id) AS turbines_measured
FROM __availability /* Generated by Cortex */;

WITH __availability AS (
  SELECT
    turbine_id,
    availability_pct AS turbine_availability_pct
  FROM WIND_OPS_AI.SERVING.MET_AVAILABILITY_CONTRACTUAL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(turbine_availability_pct), 2) AS fleet_availability_pct,
  COUNT(turbine_id) AS turbines_measured
FROM __availability /* Generated by Cortex */;

probes.prompt: What's the LD exposure if availability drops 3%?
probes.expect: Compute from the metric view, or state it cannot
probes.answer:
If availability drops 3% across the fleet, total LD exposure would rise from ₹14.3 L to ₹1.14 Cr — an increase of ₹99.3 L.

Currently only Tirunelveli is in shortfall (1.3 points below its 97% guarantee). A 3% drop would push all six sites below guarantee, with the largest exposure at Tirunelveli (₹47.3 L) and Kutch (₹31.6 L).




This is a run-rate estimate over the current window, not an invoice. Actual damages are assessed annually per the contract.
sql:
WITH __ld AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    guarantee_pct,
    ld_exposure_run_rate_inr,
    shortfall_pct,
    availability_pct AS site_availability_pct
  FROM WIND_OPS_AI.SERVING.MET_LD_EXPOSURE
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  site_availability_pct,
  guarantee_pct,
  shortfall_pct,
  ld_exposure_run_rate_inr
FROM __ld
ORDER BY
  site_availability_pct ASC /* Generated by Cortex */;

WITH __site AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    site_name
  FROM WIND_OPS_AI.RAW.DIM_SITE
), __turbine AS (
  SELECT
    turbine_id,
    site_code
  FROM WIND_OPS_AI.RAW.DIM_TURBINE
), __ld AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    guarantee_pct,
    ld_exposure_run_rate_inr,
    shortfall_pct,
    availability_pct AS site_availability_pct
  FROM WIND_OPS_AI.SERVING.MET_LD_EXPOSURE
)
SELECT
  s.site_code,
  s.site_name,
  COUNT(t.turbine_id) AS turbine_count,
  ld.site_availability_pct AS current_availability_pct,
  ld.guarantee_pct,
  ld.shortfall_pct AS current_shortfall_pct,
  ld.ld_exposure_run_rate_inr AS current_ld_exposure_inr,
  ld.site_availability_pct /* Calculate new availability if it drops 3% */ - 3.0 AS new_availability_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN ld.guarantee_pct - (
      ld.site_availability_pct - 3.0
    ) > 0
    THEN ld.guarantee_pct - (
      ld.site_availability_pct - 3.0
    )
    ELSE 0
  END AS new_shortfall_pct, /* Calculate new shortfall (guarantee - new availability), but only if positive */
  CASE
    WHEN ld.guarantee_pct - (
      ld.site_availability_pct - 3.0
    ) > 0
    THEN (
      ld.guarantee_pct - (
        ld.site_availability_pct - 3.0
      )
    ) * COUNT(t.turbine_id) * 50000
    ELSE 0
  END AS new_ld_exposure_inr, /* Calculate new LD exposure: shortfall * turbine_count * 50000 */
  CASE
    WHEN ld.guarantee_pct - (
      ld.site_availability_pct - 3.0
    ) > 0
    THEN (
      ld.guarantee_pct - (
        ld.site_availability_pct - 3.0
      )
    ) * COUNT(t.turbine_id) * 50000 - ld.ld_exposure_run_rate_inr
    ELSE -ld.ld_exposure_run_rate_inr
  END AS increase_in_ld_exposure_inr /* Calculate the increase in LD exposure */
FROM __site AS s
INNER JOIN __turbine AS t
  ON s.site_code = t.site_code
INNER JOIN __ld AS ld
  ON s.site_code = ld.site_code
GROUP BY
  s.site_code,
  s.site_name,
  ld.site_availability_pct,
  ld.guarantee_pct,
  ld.shortfall_pct,
  ld.ld_exposure_run_rate_inr
ORDER BY
  increase_in_ld_exposure_inr DESC /* Generated by Cortex */;
